styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF fields for packshots, cool light grey #E8EBEF for the tier ladder and proof close, lake-blue #1F6FB2 and grey #B9BDC2 panels only inside the two-column comparison, real outdoor training surfaces for scene shots

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium fitness-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cool light grey #E8EBEF, one lake-blue accent panel #1F6FB2 and deep charcoal #2D2D2D; neutral tone across studio and daylight shots; modern geometric sans-serif kept out of frame on main images; consistent thin-line single-color icon style shown as blank slots; backgrounds alternate between seamless white, cool light grey and real training surfaces, never random textures; soft even key light with a declared direction and true contact shadows that ground every loop; matte band surface rendering with controlled highlights; stable set scale and centered placement with generous clean margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no on-image brand wording.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 五条不同分级色的环形带斜向铺开、左下角一只束口收纳袋，纯白底；002 五条水平等距排成分色阶梯，纯白底；003 户外硬地上带体套于膝上做徒手深蹲的侧面训练照，人物面部可辨；004 庭院石墙边坐姿、带体固定在脚底做坐姿蹬拉的侧面训练照，背景为棕榈绿植；005 左右双栏对比信息图，左栏竖排五条带加六行图标与文字、右栏松散堆叠的普通带加六行图标与文字。品类判定：以图为准，产品是抗阻训练用小器材，判为运动户外/健身训练，源类目线索仅作检索参考。已剥离：原品牌字标与系列名、带面与袋身的印刷字样、档位磅数与拉力数值、005 全部原句文案与竞品暗示、两位模特面容与身份、平台徽章与星级；图内文案位一律改为空白条与空证明框，产品以 {product} 占位。
